subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should OpenClaw support Control UI hard-refresh/public assets from arbitrary unconfigured deep routes, or is the supported contract limited to root, configured `gateway.controlUi.basePath`, and the internal `/__openclaw__/` namespace?
rationale: Current main has shipped fixes for root/configured public assets but still intentionally returns 404 for unconfigured prefixed public files, and changing the Vite/gateway asset contract can affect reverse-proxy and mounted UI behavior.

options.title: Define and fix deep-route support
options.body: Treat the follow-up evidence as in-scope and land a narrow fix that proves favicon, manifest, CSS, JS, and service worker behavior under root, configured basePath, and supported deep routes.

options.title: Close as covered by current contract
options.body: Declare root/configured-base behavior sufficient, close this issue, and close or reject the linked fork PR as superseded by the shipped helper and related merged fixes.

options.title: Track a narrower follow-up
options.body: Close this broad report only after opening or linking a specific issue for the remaining deep-route/public-asset contract.

recommendation.title: Define and fix deep-route support
recommendation.body: Treat the follow-up evidence as in-scope and land a narrow fix that proves favicon, manifest, CSS, JS, and service worker behavior under root, configured basePath, and supported deep routes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the shipped public-asset helper and the recent Control UI routing refactor that now owns the moved UI asset helpers.
